versions.changelog:
- Initial release of alibabacloud-oss-client-tools-diagnosis skill.
- Provides read-only diagnosis for OSS client tool (ossbrowser, ossutil) errors and failures.
- Returns troubleshooting steps, configuration, and least-privilege policy templates strictly based on an embedded catalog and official documentation.
- Does not execute client commands, make cloud API calls, or perform any writes; all reasoning is catalog-based.
- Requires only tool name and complete error message from the user; handles boundary and scope strictly per documented rules.
